title: Delivery & Capstone
description: Study migration and rollback planning, performance checks tied to behavior, communicate validation and limitations, and capstone: implement a reviewable feature. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Migration and rollback planning
lessons.description: Plan forward and backward compatibility checks.
lessons.conceptOverview: Changes to stored data require a migration strategy and validation on representative old records. A rollback may need data compatibility, not merely reverting source code.
lessons.whyItMatters: Rollback planning must include persisted data behavior.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Changes to stored data require a migration strategy and validation on representative old records. A rollback may need data compatibility, not merely reverting source code.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Changes to stored data require a migration strategy and validation on representative old records. A rollback may need data compatibility, not merely reverting source code.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: A release writes a new enum value that the previous app version cannot read.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Plan forward and backward compatibility checks. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Rollback planning must include persisted data behavior.
commonMistakes: Reverting code always restores compatibility with newly written data.

lessons.title: Performance checks tied to behavior
lessons.description: Create a representative benchmark and identify the growth pattern.
lessons.conceptOverview: Measure the workload affected by a change and compare meaningful baselines. Avoid optimizing unmeasured code or using tiny synthetic inputs that miss production scaling.
lessons.whyItMatters: Performance evidence needs realistic input size and workload.

lessons.title: Communicate validation and limitations
lessons.description: Write a delivery note that clearly separates tested behavior from the remaining gap.
lessons.conceptOverview: Report what changed, which checks ran and any unresolved limitations. Distinguish verified results from assumptions so reviewers can make informed release decisions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Validation reports should state their practical limits.

lessons.title: Capstone: implement a reviewable feature
lessons.description: Deliver a focused diff, migration evidence and behavior checks.
lessons.conceptOverview: Choose a small feature with persisted state and an error path. Map the code, define acceptance cases, implement the change and verify both fresh and existing data before preparing a concise review.
lessons.whyItMatters: A complete coding task includes compatibility and verification.
